premises.text: Orbital debris at extreme speeds threatens satellites and can trigger Kessler cascade making orbits unusable
premises.evidence_span: At those speeds, a small fragment the size of a penny can destroy a multimillion-dollar satellite, not only ending that mission, but they create new debris that, of course, threatens other satellites. In a chain reaction known as Kessler syndrome
